notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
New Supper Banana! Version 1.1.2

In this update there are some bug fixes.


  Fixed player getting stuck inside an enemy
  Fixed missing rain in a small portion in level 2
  Edited credits a little

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
New Supper Banana! Version 1.1.1

  Fixed one type of enemy walking in air.
  Fixed trees going in front of text box in level 2.
  Fixed Banana going outside room in level 3.
  Moved a tree a little so it doesn't look like you can walk on it when you actually can't.

notes.title: New Supper Banana! Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Small update to New Supper Banana! (Version 1.0.2)

notes.title: Release date announced
notes.notes:
The content of the game is finished. Currently I'm working on cutscene skip functions and bug fixes. And release date will be announced now!

New Supper Banana! release date: 15.12.2021
